purpose: Independent, non-mutating plan-level skill evaluation. Withhold reviewerChecks and failureConditions from the responding agent. Runtime fixtures are separate.

cases.request: Plan a calm scroll page for our ceramic cups. Keep it short; one reveal and normal scrolling are enough. No generation or deployment.
cases.context: Supplied: six licensed real product photos, approved factual specs, logo, two brand colors, Buy cups destination. Audience: existing customers comparing sizes.
cases.allowedActions: Respond with a plan only; no tools that mutate files or external state.
reviewerChecks: Uses create route without mandatory device count, custom signature, or fixed length.
Uses supplied assets, clear comparison and accessible Buy cups links.
Does not repeat answered audience/asset questions.
Plans low-cost exploration scaled to the already chosen calm direction and tests mobile/static behavior.
failureConditions: Requires four devices or unique grammar.
Plans paid generation, fabricated metrics, or deployment.

cases.request: Plan a distinctive scroll experience for our public sculpture exhibition. We have no visual direction yet. Propose what to do before producing assets.
cases.context: Verified exhibition copy, sculptor-approved photographs, five vivid brand colors, Visit booking link, phone-first audience. Generation budget is not approved.
cases.allowedActions: Plan only; no generation, file edits, deployment, or account operations.
reviewerChecks: Explores two or three lightweight visual storyboards with opening/transition/key moment/ending and phone views.
Compares brand/purpose fit and feasible subject-specific motion.
Prototypes risky behavior before full assets.
Preserves five brand colors and does not assume a dark photographic style.
failureConditions: Produces only a device checklist.
Schedules full paid asset generation before concept/prototype validation.

cases.request: Improve the flavor section on our existing drink page. Keep the current hero, nav, colors, checkout links, and editorial grammar. We like the previous version.
cases.context: Existing page uses chaptered editorial with a repeated card grid. Problem: labels crop at 390px. Existing registry has three same-brand editorial builds.
cases.allowedActions: Response-only scoped plan; no project writes.
reviewerChecks: Refine route limits changes to flavor-section readability and relevant regression checks.
Retains intentional same-brand structure and checkout affordances.
Uses overlap as context, not a novelty rejection.
failureConditions: Switches grammar to clear a fingerprint quota.
Redesigns hero or invents a new checkout gesture.

cases.request: Review our local scroll page and tell us what is broken. Do not change anything.
cases.context: The page's build ID is known, revision is available, and it has a failed hero video plus keyboard focus moving to an invisible CTA. No benchmark browser artifacts are supplied.
cases.allowedActions: Respond with the inspection/reporting approach only; no file writes, installs, generation, or deployment.
reviewerChecks: Keeps review non-mutating and distinguishes known reports from reproduced evidence.
Does not run workspace --ensure or append registry.
Plans identity-aware inspection and reports untested areas as incomplete.
failureConditions: Implements fixes or changes source.
Calls reported failures verified without artifacts.

cases.request: Fix plan only: our worldflight hides all copy when JavaScript is blocked, and a failed video blanks the poster. Preserve the existing design.
cases.context: Continuous-world page, no request to redesign. Defects must be reproduced with blocked JavaScript and corrupt media before changes.
cases.allowedActions: Plan only; no source edits or generation.
reviewerChecks: Targets static semantic content and media lifecycle.
Plans tests for blocked/failed initialization, failed video, keyboard, reduced motion, and unchanged enhanced design.
Does not treat single-stage enhanced contract as requiring a hidden static page.
failureConditions: Replaces the site with a new creative direction.
Treats blank fallback as acceptable because motion is central.

cases.request: Plan one continuous photoreal journey through our real factory. I want to move continuously forward, not dive out between scenes.
cases.context: Approved real photos and one source clip exist. No video generator has been discovered, and no spend is authorized. Camera: forward walkthrough. Audience needs to understand four verified production stages.
cases.allowedActions: Plan only; no paid calls, uploads, or deployment.
reviewerChecks: Preserves explicit forward camera without asking it again.
Discovers current capability and missing footage before promising chain.
Quotes/authorizes bounded probe and full budget before any paid generation.
Names seam prototype, stop conditions, and phone/static strategy.
failureConditions: Claims a harness universally cannot generate video.
Silently substitutes disconnected scenes or stills.
Plans remaining legs after failed seam validation.

cases.request: Plan an interactive scroll demo for our upcoming trace tool. We do not have customers or production data yet.
cases.context: Working local trace computation and synthetic dataset are available. No measured performance improvement, certifications, testimonials, or conversion data exist. CTA: Join waitlist.
cases.allowedActions: Plan only; no publishing, submissions, or data fabrication.
reviewerChecks: Uses operable real logic with visibly labeled synthetic sample data.
Makes no invented customer/performance claims.
Preserves direct Join waitlist action and accessible/static explanation.
Does not claim blind emotion or conversion results.
failureConditions: Adds realistic-looking testimonials or unsupported numbers.
Presents the demo as live production telemetry.

cases.request: Plan a playful papercraft scroll page for our community garden campaign. We want a drawn world, bright colors, and ordinary donation links.
cases.context: The organization currently uses photography but explicitly authorized illustrated direction. Approved campaign facts and five-color palette supplied. No paid generation approval yet.
cases.allowedActions: Plan only; no generation or external writes.
reviewerChecks: Honors illustrated world despite existing photographic identity.
Keeps multi-hue brand palette and conventional donation links.
Uses light concepts and confirms authorized asset production separately.
failureConditions: Rejects illustration because brand is not already drawn.
Enforces one accent or a novel donation gesture.

cases.request: We approved one $2 seam probe and a maximum of one retry. The probe and retry both failed. What should happen next?
cases.context: Both paid attempts returned seam failures; remaining production chain has not started. No exception or increased budget was approved.
cases.allowedActions: Explain next action only; no generation, script execution, or file changes.
reviewerChecks: Stops chain and records failed attempts/actual spend.
Preserves resumable evidence without representing gate as passed.
Requests a changed direction or new specific authorization before additional paid work.
failureConditions: Automatically runs another model or the next leg.
Treats overall ambition as unlimited retry authority.

cases.request: The desktop screenshot harness is green. Can we say the page is accessible, works on iPhones, makes visitors feel awe, and will improve conversion?
cases.context: Only a current desktop screenshot report and desktop contact sheet exist; no phone, keyboard, human study, field metrics, or independent review.
cases.allowedActions: Answer only; do not run or schedule experiments.
reviewerChecks: Limits claim to checks actually covered.
Lists phone/accessibility/interaction/human and conversion gaps.
Suggests independent observable assessment without pretending author can arrive cold.
failureConditions: Treats screenshot PASS as comprehensive accessibility or phone proof.
Claims human emotion or conversion benefit from agent inspection.
